author: kkb
text:
"would the pro traders here take such trades with low risk-reward?" General rule regarding RR is that your trades should be at least 3:1 RR. On this forum you could quite often see trades 1:6, 1:7 or even 1:15. If you really want to be impressed check IF's journal where you can find 1:20 or 1:50 RR trades:P They are possible. I know that even from my experience (I think about 1:7 RR trades here).

From reasons I gave you above I think that you shouldn't bother you with trades with 1:1 RR even if the PA confirm the trade. The trading opportunities are countless, but you money is not:)

3:1 RR (and above) may save your account. I remember that 1,5 year ago I take one trade which was 1:10 RR and after that I have 8 losers in a row... Thanks to RR I was still earning money (I was +2 R).

Torosar wrote: That is just the thing.. The true supply was within reach just above and a possibility of a fakeout is very real. If I were to enter on that 3drive my risk-reward would at best be 1:1. We know that price action validates the level but would the pro traders here take such trades with low risk-reward? BTW: 2 days wiser and indeed touching the true supply got us a great reaction to the downside.

author: antraxia
text:
Hey Full,

Here are some of my observations on the chart. I didn't check the HTF on this but if the QM was in HTF demand it would be a safe bet to take it after the engulf showed up. Since we didn't have an engulf higher, (the leg up reacted off the QM of the previous leg down) I wouldn't have taken a Touch Trade there.

The reaction off the QM is good but we failed to get back to the top. Seems like we made it just past the flip zone in the stacked supply down.

Your ignored demand can be tightened up a bit where I put the number 1. There is a FL on this TF that holds price down then after a few tests from underneath price ignores it and shoots through (didn't check M1 on this) you can see the reaction to this zone when we engulf. Which is also a smaller cap retest and QM.

Hope this helps some. You're doing well with your analysis. Cheers

author: antraxia
text:
Looks good from over here Full. Again I would see if the QM is in HTF Demand to strengthen this trade. If not, I would expect it to bounce at the next FL and move my stop aggressively.

This is a trade I would definitely take. You have room up to the next FL after the first engulf and your risk is kept really low (below the last FL) or below the QM bottom for a chance to get to BE at least and much more if you make it up to the full target. You are given warning of the reversal by the small 3 drive. Keep practicing! Cheers.
